title: Carroll-Weyl gauged null strings in AdS
summary: We study the Carroll-Weyl gauged null string in the Poincaré patch of $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ and its BRST quantization. In Poincaré coordinates $X^A=(z,x^i)$, the radial conformal Killing vector $K=\partial_z$ becomes homothetic in a suitable conformally related frame. A field-dependent rescaling of the homothetic Hamiltonian constraint then leads to the radial-adapted basis $\mathcal{M}=\frac{1}{2}(P_z^2+P_iP^i)$, $\mathcal{L}=-P_AX'^A$, and $\mathcal{S}=P_z$, with $\mathcal{M}$ invariant along the Carroll-Weyl radial flow.
